$10 OpenCode Go + DeepSeek V4-Flash is exposing something important.

People are generating serious volume of code and still sitting at 10% of their weekly limit.

That’s not a bug.
That’s what happens when the active parameter count is low enough to multi-serve cheaply while agent performance holds.

The old model was:
Pay $200 → hope the limits don’t hit mid-task.

The new pattern is:
Route bulk execution to efficient specialists.
Keep the expensive models for judgment only.

When a $10 plan feels like a $200 one, the control plane becomes the real product.

This is the cost curve TORQ is built around.
